description: Provision a Google Cloud Sql SQLDatabase via Config Connector. Fields mirror the sql.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 SQLDatabase spec.

charset.description:
The charset value. See MySQL's
[Supported Character Sets and Collations](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/5.7/en/charset-charsets.html)
and Postgres' [Character Set Support](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/9.6/static/multibyte.html)
for more details and supported values. Postgres databases only support
a value of 'UTF8' at creation time.

collation.description:
The collation value. See MySQL's
[Supported Character Sets and Collations](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/5.7/en/charset-charsets.html)
and Postgres' [Collation Support](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/9.6/static/collation.html)
for more details and supported values. Postgres databases only support
a value of 'en_US.UTF8' at creation time.

deletionPolicy.description:
The deletion policy for the database. Setting ABANDON allows the resource
to be abandoned rather than deleted. This is useful for Postgres, where databases cannot be
deleted from the API if there are users other than cloudsqlsuperuser with access. Possible
values are: "ABANDON", "DELETE". Defaults to "DELETE".

instanceRef.description: The Cloud SQL instance. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `SQLInstance` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

title: GCP Sql SQLDatabase
